Not to mention the high British quality, how well it performs, and how adaptable it is for a variety of current builds that require modern details.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External Angle
product.description: This deep run external angle from Alumasc’s Aqualine guttering range has all the benefits of an Aqualine half round external angle – designed to explore outwardly (external) corners of a roofline and avoid any potential obstructions – but does it with a deeper profile that can contain more water and therefore withstand a greater amount of rain. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External AngleWide colour palette with polyester powder coatings approved by BBA (British Board of Agrément)  Choice of angles for versatile applications  Aqualine products are patented and ‘Design Registered’  Made to high British standards (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6) in the UK.
product.variant_name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run 135dg External Angle in White - 110mm x 85mm

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running Outlet
product.description: The deep run running outlet connects the gutter and downpipe outlet in Aqualine deep run systems so that rainwater can easily continue on and flow through the drainage system without problem. Specifically for use in Alumasc’s Aqualine deep run guttering, this aluminium product comfortably allows for high volumes of water. Extruded aluminium is what makes this deep run running outlet so tough and versatile with rigorous defiance against breakage and splintering under changing weather circumstances. The deep run profile sufficiently holds and channels vast quantities of rainwater towards the drainage system, and Alumasc’s advanced technology makes for guttering that looks neat, current, and modern and that can also withstand the common changes of thermal movement at the same time. product.description: Supplied with a moulded gutter and applicable brackets, union clips, and sidelocks for reliable and unwavering installation, this 3m moulded gutter assembly allows you to set up an Alumasc aluminium gutter run within the rest of an Aqualine system.Aqualine is one of Alumasc’s several high-performing rainwater ranges. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter Pack
product.description: This Alumasc Aqualine starter pack contains P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This includes all the necessary tools to help you to commence an easy and successful installation process of the Moulded extruded aluminium gutter system.This starter pack ensures a quick and easy installation using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing. This starter pack secures intricate details and smooth lines with a modern appearance for contemporary designed buildings with a completely clean outer appearance.  This lightweight and easy to handle, starter pack ensures the Moulded gutters can be locked and dropped into place onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear. This safeguards the entire gutter system is completely secure while allowing free linear thermal movement at every joint.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter PackQuick and easy to install your Moulded gutter system  Once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric all remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix  Helps to enhance your building with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a completely clean appearance  Environmentally friendly and made from durable, long-life, recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to handle materials  Minimal maintenance required  Available in two different gutter diameter sizes  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)This Moulded guttering system has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, while this starter pack is suited to help install both flush and projecting eaves applications.  Once installed, this gutter system requires minimal maintenance, made from long-lasting, durable and non-corrodible aluminium. Available in two different sizes, this starter pack is quick and easy to help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This lightweight and durable stop-end is available in two different sizes, a wide selection of colours and left or right-handed, depending on the side of your installation needs. This moulded stop-end requires minimal maintenance once installed and is completely secure.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Stop-End
product.description: This Box stop-end is made to stop water from flowing around your building’s gutters continuously and helps direct the water into a running or gutter outlet into the rainwater system below. Designed to fit with the Box Aqualine extruded aluminium guttering system, this stop-end has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape and maximises the capacity of water flow while providing a striking angular appearance and uniformity in shape.This Aqualine stop-end displays intricate detailing and smooth lines, enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings. Ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this stop-end is part of an efficient and compact rainwater system. This stop-end enhances performance and high flow capacity while fully accommodating free linear thermal movement. Made from non-corrodible and durable aluminium, this stop-end is available in a variety of colours, range of sizes and left or right-handed.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Stop-EndManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Made with BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Environmentally friendly and made from recyclable aluminium  Made from non-corrodible and durable aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/ suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas)  Easy to install and light in weight to handle  Little to no maintenance after installation  Gives a clean appearance, enhancing buildings with smooth lines, intricate details and secret fix bracketry  Available in a wide variety of colours and sizes to choose from with left and right-handed stop-ends  Has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance and suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applicationsThis, lightweight and easy to handle and fix, stop-end uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system giving a completely clean external appearance. The Aqualine Box gutters can drop and lock onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear, ensuring a completely secure guttering stop-end.

product.description: This internal angle guttering has been designed to fit around corners of buildings and in conjunction with the Alumasc Aqualine Box extruded aluminium guttering system to help direct the flow of rainwater into a gutter or running outlet into a water system below. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this internal angle contributes to an efficient and compact rainwater system. Manufactured from durable and non-corrosive aluminium and available in a range of colours, diameters and angles, this internal angle can be made to fit your gutting needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Internal AngleManufactured in the United Kingdom to British standards  Made with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Made from recyclable aluminium and environmentally friendly  Made from robust and non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years for rural /suburban areas and up to 25 years for industrial/marine areas  Ideal for enhancing buildings with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a clean appearance  Light in weight and easy to install and handle  Minimal maintenance once installed  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Available in a range of colours, diameters and anglesQuick and easy to install, this lightweight internal angle uses a unique dry jointing system to give a completely clean external appearance. This Aqualine Internal angle gutter can drop and lock onto concealed brackets with locked and aligned internal joints using slide/lock bars situated at the front and rear. Ensuring a completely secure gutter system, this internal angle allows for free linear thermal movement.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of your roof, this gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run that channels the water away into a downpipe and into the rainwater system below. This high-capacity gutter is suitable for traditional or modern buildings and has been manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Made with moulded sides and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is part of a gutter system that has been fully engineered for a traditional, well-proven installation method of simple wet sealed and bolted joints, fixed directly to your building fabric. With a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry, generally concealed after fixing, this gutter assembly is lightweight and easy to install with minimal maintenance required after installation. This gutter assembly can be exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system, is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system and can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyMade in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in a selection of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required for a long-lasting installation  Made from 100% recyclable, environmentally friendly aluminium  Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a selection of diameters  Easy to install with a simple, well-proven method and light in weight to handle  Wet jointed and fixed directly to building fabricThis robust and non-corrodible aluminium gutter assembly can reduce the risk of heat damage, avoiding splitting and cracking by fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. Available in a selection of diameters and colours, this gutter assembly is coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder to suit your gutter requirements. Made from long-lasting aluminium, this gutter assembly has a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia Bracket
product.description: This Box Fascia Bracket has been manufactured to provide support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system. Made from durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this fascia bracket has a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas) with minimal maintenance required.This lightweight, straightforward bracket is easy to install and handle. Once fixed to the building fabric, the only remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix, dropping and locking the guttering onto this concealed bracket with locked and aligned internal joints using lock bars to ensure completely secure guttering. This fascia bracket uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance contributing to the smooth lines and intricate detailing to enhance and complement the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia BracketManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Available in a variety of colours to match your gutters  Provides support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system  Made from recyclable aluminium and is environmentally friendly  Manufactured from durable and non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance required  Available in a range of diameters  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves  Easy to install and lightweightSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications and available in a wide range of sizes and in a variety of colours with BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coatings to match your gutter system.  This Box fascia bracket is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Box guttering, supported by this fascia bracket has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape to maximise water flow capacity and gives a striking angular appearance with a uniform shape.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Starter Pack
product.description:
This box starter pack is mainly manufactured from aluminium, and is part of the Aqualine range of aluminium guttering from Alumasc. With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
This starter pack has been designed specifically for use with box profile guttering from the Aqualine range. The box profile is a contemporary design with sharp angular lines to create a strong visual statement, as well as maximum capacity and efficient flow rates.
The starter pack has been designed to provide you with everything you need to install box profile Aqualine guttering securely, to create a durable and weathertight run of guttering on your property. The box profile starter pack consists of 10 spare lock bars, 20 shims, 2 jointing tools, 20 no.12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and P80 joint and seal lubricant, to create a pristine, built to last finish.
Why choose Alumasc Aqualine guttering?
The Alumasc Aqualine range of guttering is part of the contemporary aluminium rainwater range from Alumasc.
Performance and design
The Alumasc Aqualine guttering system features a number of characteristics that make it one of the highest performing gutter systems available. The design of Aqualine takes into account potential dangers of cracking and splitting due to thermal movement, so at every joint across the gutter system thermal movement can occur without causing damage.
The Aqualine gutter system has also been designed to be installed with concealed fixing and jointing, which not only helps to create a clean external appearance, but also helps minimise the potential for leaks to occur. This is further aided by the dry joint seals, which are secured by sliding lock bars for maximum watertightness.
Installation
The installation process of Alumasc Aqualine is quick and easy, aided by the fact that the gutters are lightweight and easy to handle. Support brackets simply need to be fixed to the building fabric, and then a simple clip fix is all that is required to secure the gutter in place.
Aesthetics
The Aqualine range is available in a vast range of colours, sizes and profiles, which allow a high level of customisation in order to create the perfect look for your project. Whether you’re looking to create a subtle guttering run with relatively traditional profiles, or you want to make the gutters a feature, in bright colours and contemporary profiles, the Alumasc Aqualine range will have exactly what you are looking for, with BBA approved polyester powder coatings, and including all the accessories you’ll need to create a single, uniform look.
Environmentally friendly
The Aqualine guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the Aqualine guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

Innovative technology has gone into the Aqualine gutter collection by Alumasc to create products that hold up to high standards. Featuring strong aluminium constructions that combat corrosion and rusting, the Aqualine range pre-empts damage that can occur during thermal movement and is therefore designed to allow the space for this process. Not only light and ideal for long-term use, but this guttering also looks tidy with hidden bracketry, as well as withstands leaks with sliding locks for joints. With an assortment of sizes, colours, and models, this box running outlet can be picked to perfectly match your Aqualine box guttering. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Running OutletEasy to install and manoeuvre  Recyclable aluminium that lasts a long time  Involves capacity for high flow  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Made in the UK.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal Angle
product.description: Designed with an internal returned lip and moulded sides, this internal angle is suited for use on the corners of your installation for modern or traditional buildings with your choice of being exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system. This internal angle has been designed as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Durable and fully engineered, this box section internal angle gutter has been designed for a traditional, well-proven method of simply wet sealing and bolting joints fixed directly onto the building fabric and is suitable for traditional or modern buildings. Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required, this internal angle is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, reducing the risk of cracking or splitting through heat damage. Providing an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution, this internal angle is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit solution and requires a simple screw fixing with bracketry which is generally concealed after installation.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded Internal AngleManufactured in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in two different colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium for minimal maintenance and a long-lasting installation  Made from environmentally friendly and 100% recyclable aluminium  Ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a range of angles and diameters  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and simple method   Wet jointed and fixed directly to the building fabricAvailable in a range of diameters and angles, this lightweight internal angle is made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance required after installation. Available in your choice of two colours, this internal angle is coated with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder.

product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded External Angle
product.description: With 90º or 135º options for your guttering requirements, this external angle features a moulded profile that renders it ideal for the GX moulded collection of aluminium guttering systems from Alumasc. This moulded external angle is a terrific and efficient way of directing guttering around the corners of builds, either modern or more traditional, and creating an unbroken path that accommodates rainwater flow even with shifts in the roofline. You can install this to the rest of your moulded gutter with GX moulded union clips and, alongside Alumasc’s fellow aluminium products, it can be recycled once its long-term use has been achieved. product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: With this 3m gutter assembly, you will be able to successfully and easily install a guttering run that works in perfect tandem with the aluminium GX smooth guttering range from Alumasc. The GX range is one of many brilliant guttering ranges by Alumasc. product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This aluminium moulded stop end is a light, well-manufactured, and useful addition to your GX moulded guttering systems. Alumasc provides you with a reliable fitting to assist you in draining water and carrying it through the guttering. This stop end – purchasable in both left and right hand depending on use – attaches to the moulded running outlet and aims to prevent rainwater from floating around in the gutter run to keep your GX moulded system flowing effectively. Produced to high standards, Alumasc’s moulded range from the GX guttering collection is long-lasting and includes larger sizes to compensate for heavier rainfall. This stop end works fantastically to function with the rest of the GX moulded products and forms a watertight seal to avoid irritating leakages. product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth Internal Angle
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Smooth gutter system, this internal angle has been designed for simple jointing for a sleek appearance without the requirement for sole support brackets and visible screw fixing. product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth Standard Running Outlet
product.description: Created for functional use alongside the innovative variety of GX aluminium gutter products, this smooth standard running outlet is specially crafted to let rainwater flow into the system by connecting gutter runs to downpipes. The Alumasc GX collection is a versatile and high-quality range, designed for simple installation that looks stylish and put together on application, whether it be contemporary builds or traditional. Strength and longevity are only two fantastic benefits of GX systems, with an endless list of advantages to follow – including rust deterring aluminium and leeway for heat-related expansion and contraction. GX smooth is particularly professional in finish, specifically intended to keep screws concealed, with a modern wall construction with a soft lip that lives up to that smooth name. This outlet performs fantastically with the rest of the smooth GX structure. Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Smooth Standard Running OutletColour options include graphite and white  Aluminium construction lessens maintenance and optimises strength for a long-lasting product  Lightweight for handling with little effort  Recyclable  Highly efficient with BBA (British Board of Agrément) approval.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Access Pipe
product.description: This access pipe is from Alumasc’s Flushjoint downpipe collection, particularly from the array of square fittings and guttering they offer. It works in the same manner as a regular downpipe, except it has an opening where you can clear any blockages with relative ease. The Flushjoint range performs just as efficiently as Alumasc’s fellow ranges, to the point that it can be used in tandem with GX, Aqualine and Heritage products that can accommodate to Flushjoint sizes and connections. With an assortment of colour options that all contain BBA approved (British Board of Agrément) polyester powder, this square profile access pipe makes a fantastic contribution to modern or refurbished builds that suit slick and discreet joints. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Access PipeSize variation  Up to 40 year life expectation  Recyclable extruded aluminium (grade 6063 T6) that is unlikely to rust, crack, and corrode  Suited to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 755)  Versatile and easy to install  UK made.

product.description: For long-lasting, lightweight, and reliable usage, this square profile pipe shoe bottoms off the downpipe section to your aluminium Alumasc guttering systems and directs rainwater to the ground level drain in situations where the downpipe does not. Whether they be on industrial uses or in rural neighbourhoods, the life expectancy of this pipe shoe – and the wider variety of Flushpipe accessories – can last upwards of 25 and 40 years, in turn providing you with an incredibly durable and highly sufficient aluminium fitting that won’t disappoint. Crafted from exceptional extruded aluminium (from grade 6063 T6 alloy), this Flushjoint square downpipe is immensely durable, greatly lightweight, and very simple to install in contemporary applications where buildings are new or being refurbished. Alumasc made their Flushjoint downpipe collection versatile in that it can be used alongside Alumasc’s other aluminium ranges where the sizing of pipes is suitable, such as the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage ranges, and offers just as many benefits – including recyclability, smooth connections, and modern aesthetics. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square DownpipeAssorted colour palette from polyester powder coatings, BBA approved (British Board of Agrément)  Available in different sizes for an array of applications  Aluminium constructed to quality British standards (with BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 755 standards met)  Seamless, slick hidden spigot connections  Recyclable  UK created.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe Bend
product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 92.5 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This square profile two part offset is an immensely useful product designed to connect your running outlet to your downpipe and restore it to the wall where it can be fixed accordingly.The offset accommodates a 92.5° angle and involves concealed spigots that create seamless attachments between parts. Aluminium guttering by Alumasc is excellent in quality, easy to set up, and 100% recyclable at the end of its long-term use. Being that it is a member of the Flushjoint range of Alumasc guttering, this offset can be just as useful in a GX, Heritage, or Aqualine guttering system on up-to-date builds with contemporary layouts, as long as the paired items are completely compatible with the offset. Aluminium guttering by Alumasc is excellent in quality, easy to set up, and 100% recyclable at the end of its long-term use. Being that it is a member of the Flushjoint range of Alumasc guttering, this offset can be just as useful in a GX, Heritage, or Aqualine guttering system on up-to-date builds with contemporary layouts, as long as the paired items are completely compatible with the offset. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed Offset
product.description: With just one part, this 135° fixed offset is one of the multiple products in the Flush joint range from Alumasc. The squared profile works perfectly with other squared profile downpipe systems, connecting them together with smooth hidden spigots.Flushjoint systems attach at the gutter running outlet and connect down towards the downpipe. This offset plays an important part in providing this connection – allowing a 135° angle to keep the downpipes firmly fixed on the wall with appropriate brackets, as well as forming a continuous path for rainfall to find the drainage system. As one of Alumasc’s ranges, Flushjoint is constructed from non-corrosive and long-lasting extruded aluminium suitable for contemporary buildings and modern aesthetics. Although in the Flushjoint range, this square offset can be placed in Heritage, GX, and Aqualine gutters so long as the products are compatible. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed OffsetManufactured in the UK to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)Optional colours with BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powderSquare profileLow maintenance aluminiumSimple to install with spigotsBeneficial to the environment due to recyclability

product.name: Caroflow LoLine Vinyl Floor Shower Outlet
product.description:
Caroflow LoLine Shower Outlet bodies are manufactured in pre-treated, electrostatically applied powder coated, diecast LM6 Aluminium Silicon alloy. The clamp and cover plate are manufactured in diecast corrosion resistant zinc. They can be supplied chrome plated or powder coated.
The LoLine will connect to all proprietary 40mm compression or push-fit systems, achieving a constant flow in excess of 0.45 litres per second.
The unit incorporates a removable trap which allows for cleaning and rodding through to the main drainage pipe.

product.name: Caroflow Roof Drain Threaded Adaptor
product.description: From Caroflow, this roof drain threaded adaptor is used to extend the length of outlets. With a male taper at one end compliant with BS21, this adaptor is perfect for joining into any Caroflow threaded connection outlets. From vertical threaded to two-way outlets and more. The other end is chamfered to BSEN 1566:2004 spigot dimensions and comes in a variety of sizes to ensure you find the right size for your outlet. As an extending section, this adaptor can be used whenever extra length is required. You can opt for different lengths to find the right one for your extension requirements. product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal Angle
product.description:
For gutter installations that require sharp turns of a corner or that need to avoid any potential interruptions for a straight path, this joggle internal angle is a fantastic product to connect to a joggle gutter run and therefore ensure water can flow from the gutter to the downpipe. 
This internal angle features a joggle profile as part of Alumasc’s GX joggle range, which makes it ideal to fit in with the joggle system as it shares a distinct design that accommodates heavy rainfall and utilises innovative technology, therefore allowing for thermal movement. GX gutters are suitable for high capacity flow and work fantastically on both traditional and contemporary builds. Joggle installations can be extremely discreet with easy bracketry and top straps, and this internal angle follows in line by subtly connecting to the guttering run.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal AngleSize options to suit different gutters  Resistant to corrosion and rusting  Unlikely to break or leak  Recyclable  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Perfect for longevity installations with a 25-40 year lifespan  Made from British standard aluminium (BS EN 1462:1997, BS EN 612:1996, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 485).

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Union Clip
product.description:
Designed to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint, this union clip provides support for the GX Joggle range of pressed aluminium gutter systems. Lightweight and easy to install with a simple, well-proven method, this union clip is part of the GX Joggle installation that can be fixed with wet-sealed and bolted joints with a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry that can be concealed after installation.
Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings and a range of diameters to match your GX Joggle gutter system. This fully engineered union clip, designed for traditional wet jointing on-site, is ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. This Joggle union clip has been designed with sharp-angled bends and vertical sides with the GX Joggle range made with a returned lip and a supportive top strap for increased strength and rigidity. Adaptable to modern or traditional buildings this union clip is part of the GX Joggle range that can provide a soffit solution/ all-aluminium eaves with your choice of exposed or concealed gutters.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Union ClipFully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Manufactured in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a range of colours with BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Made from robust, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance required after installation  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Light and easy to install with a well-proven and straightforward installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthManufactured with durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this union clip has a life expectancy of 40 years for suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years for marine/industrial areas with minimal maintenance required once installed. The GX Joggles gutters are made to fully accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint, reducing the risk of damage through cracking or splitting.

product.description: This Joggle stop-end can be used at the end of a gutter run to stop rainwater from running continuously around your building and helps to direct the water into an outlet through to a rainwater system below. product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Joggle gutter system range, this 3-meter gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run, designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of the roof and channel it away into the downpipe and to the rainwater system below. Light and easy to handle and install, this straightforward gutter assembly can be fixed with a simple, well-proven method with bolted and wet-sealed joints with a simple screw fixing and bracketry that can be hidden after installation to create a streamlined finish.Available in your choice of a wide variety of colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings and a range of gutter diameters to match your gutter system needs. Fully engineered and designed for traditional on-site wet jointing, this gutter assembly is perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. Made with vertical sides, sharp-angled bends and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is supported by top straps to increase rigidity and strength for your GX Joggle gutter system. Suitable for modern or traditional buildings, this adaptable gutter assembly can provide an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution and is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter AssemblyCompatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Made in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance requirements  Made from environmentally friendly, 100% recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and straightforward installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthYou can choose to expose or conceal your gutters, whichever suits your building. Made with robust and non-corrodible aluminium, this gutter assembly can fully accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint, reducing the risk of heat damage through splitting or cracking while aluminium has a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance requirements.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Standard Running Outlet
product.description:
This standard running outlet has been manufactured from aluminium and is part of the GX aluminium gutter range from Alumasc. Alumasc have been manufacturing high quality guttering and rainwater systems for years, and use new technologies and innovative manufacturing processes to create products that not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of performance, durability and design.
This standard running outlet has been designed specifically for use with GX guttering products with the joggle profile. The joggle range of GX guttering comprises of vertical sides, sharp angled bends, and a returned lip, and has been designed for use in areas of high rainfall as it copes with large volumes of water with no issues.
The running outlet provides a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, in order to transport the rainwater from the roof and into the drainage system. The running outlet is most commonly connected to a gutter run towards the side of a house, and is often paired with a stop end to ensure water gets directed into the downpipe.
Why choose Alumasc GX guttering?
Performance
The Alumasc GX gutter range has been designed specifically as a high capacity gutter that can be used on both traditional and modern buildings. The Alumasc GX range is available in three different profiles, but each profile has been designed in a way that delivers maximum capacity and flow rate.
The GX Alumasc range of guttering is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, and is lightweight, durable and highly corrosion resistant.
Installation
The GX aluminium guttering range has been designed for traditional wet jointing on site. This involves the simple and well proven method of screw fixing with bracketry, which is generally concealed after installation to create a sleek and uniform finish.
The GX Joggle range is supported by top straps, whilst the GX Smooth range has been designed to not require any visible screw fixing or support brackets to create a smooth finish, whilst the GX Moulded range is wet jointed, fixed directly to the building fabric.
Environmentally friendly
The GX guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the GX guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

Part of Alumasc's durable and long-lasting 'Heritage' range, these Victorian ogee stop ends combine period style with modern materials. Designed specifically as a direct replacement for older cast iron fittings, these stop ends boast an impressive service life of up to forty years in rural or suburban areas. Combining longevity and versatility, the Heritage system is ready for your next retrofit or ground-up guttering project with an extensive range of fixture options and minimal maintenance.
This gutter system is lightweight, durable, and highly resistant to corrosion, having earned British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval. In addition, these sections come in a range of imperial measurements as well as a variety of popular profiles, with the system serving as an excellent substitute for that characteristic cast-iron texture.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop EndHard-wearing coated aluminium means these gutters can last up to forty years in suburban and rural areasMeets with British Standards and British Board of Agrément specificationsDesigned specifically for replacing older cast-iron fixturesSuitable for both flush and projecting eave applications

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Fascia Bracket
product.description:
A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.
Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with Ears
product.description:
This round downpipe with ears is made in conjunction with the cast aluminium Alumasc Heritage rainwater system and is a perfect feature for traditionally designed buildings in both refurbishment and new build applications and can be used as a direct alternative for cast-iron downpipes.  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves installations.
Available in 1, 2 or 3 metre lengths and a range of diameters to fit your needs, this circular downpipe is made from robust and corrosion-resistant aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. Coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings, this downpipe is offered in a variety of colours with the option of a textured black surface to resemble cast iron. This downpipe provides the essential assistance for your gutter system by channelling rainwater from your roof to a drain at ground level.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with EarsManufactured in accordance with BS 8530 (previously BS 2997)  Made from extruded aluminium  Made in the UK by Alumasc for the cast aluminium Heritage rainwater system  Ideal for providing traditional architectural features for new build and refurbishment applications  A lightweight alternative for cast iron downpipes   Available in a variety of colours including textured black with BBA approved, factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Durable and non-corrosive aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas)  Easy to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Available in a range of lengths and diameters  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Compatible with modern fast track building contractsThis extruded aluminium downpipe is easy to fix with pipe jointing for up to 100mm diameters by separate sockets to give maximum flexibility and welded on sockets for the 150mm downpipe. With a straightforward fixing to the wall by eared sockets, this downpipe needs minimal maintenance once installed. Manufactured in the UK to British standards and made from 100% recyclable aluminium.

This round downpipe with ears is made in conjunction with the cast aluminium Alumasc Heritage rainwater system and is a perfect feature for traditionally designed buildings in both refurbishment and new build applications and can be used as a direct alternative for cast-iron downpipes.  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves installations.
Available in 1, 2 or 3 metre lengths and a range of diameters to fit your needs, this circular downpipe is made from robust and corrosion-resistant aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. Coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings, this downpipe is offered in a variety of colours with the option of a textured black surface to resemble cast iron. This downpipe provides the essential assistance for your gutter system by channelling rainwater from your roof to a drain at ground level.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe with EarsManufactured in accordance with BS 8530 (previously BS 2997)  Made from extruded aluminium  Made in the UK by Alumasc for the cast aluminium Heritage rainwater system  Ideal for providing traditional architectural features for new build and refurbishment applications  A lightweight alternative for cast iron downpipes   Available in a variety of colours including textured black with BBA approved, factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Durable and non-corrosive aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas)  Easy to install with minimal maintenance requirements  Available in a range of lengths and diameters  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Compatible with modern fast track building contractsThis extruded aluminium downpipe is easy to fix with pipe jointing for up to 100mm diameters by separate sockets to give maximum flexibility and welded on sockets for the 150mm downpipe. With a straightforward fixing to the wall by eared sockets, this downpipe needs minimal maintenance once installed. Manufactured in the UK to British standards and made from 100% recyclable aluminium.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Bend
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Beaded Deep Run Gutter
product.description:
These Alumasc 'Heritage' beaded deep-run gutters are the starting point for a reliable and robust range of guttering sections and fittings. An ideal pairing for traditional buildings that need every ounce of character preserved, these gutter sections are perfect for replacing older, heavier cast-iron fixtures or lending style to all sorts of contemporary builds. 
The 'Heritage' range uses durable coated aluminium to produce longevity, quality, and versatility for the best results in both flush and projecting eave applications. With British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval, this gutter system can last up to forty years in rural and suburban areas. A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style 106mm Prostyle Plastic Union Bracket
product.description:
Taking a unique and contemporary spin on a traditional style of guttering, the Cascade Prostyle range from Brett Martin features this plastic union bracket that sturdily joins together two gutter parts.
As well as uniting two pieces of guttering, this iron style union bracket provides additional support to the given joints and attachments by screwing into the fascia board where necessary. With an ogee profile, this product works splendidly on systems that find refuge in heritage style applications that strive for a distinctive design while employing all the benefits of contemporary guttering expertise. product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style 106mm Prostyle Plastic Running Outlet
product.description:

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings

Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Corner Round Plastic Downpipe
product.description:
This Roundstyle uPVC plastic downpipe aims to create a steady path that effortlessly directs rainwater towards the pipe shoe and to the drain. Including lugs for easy and quick attachments, this plastic downpipe fits neatly into a 68mm downpipe system that settles into a corner. 
Like its fellow Cascade products, this Roundstyle downpipe features a cast iron adjacent finish that creates a rustic and traditional feel. While this downpipe is suited to newer applications, it is also ideal for modern refurbishments on heritage buildings where cast iron products may need replacing. In this Cascade downpipe, Brett Martin provides a versatile product that successfully fulfills its purpose and that can increase efficiency in authentic cast iron systems. product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Running Outlet
product.description:
Straight forward installation and excellent aesthetics are provided by this visually compact yet highly efficient profiled gutter system. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.

Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Plastic 106mm Prostyle Internal Angle
product.description:
Straight forward installation and excellent aesthetics are provided by this visually compact yet highly efficient profiled gutter system. Only 106mm across, the gutter is small enough to be ideally suited to conservatories or bungalows, whilst having sufficient capacity to handle larger houses due to its unique design.
Moulded seals and fixing wings are on all relevant fittings with the option of a hidden, top hung, fascia bracket also available. Connects to 68mm Roundstyle, 65mm Squarestyle and 68mm Cast Iron Style downpipe and available in White, Black, Brown and Cast Iron Style finish.
Like all Brett Martin rainwater products the use of UV stabilised plastic is standard so that systems retain their high quality appearance thus giving excellent durability.
Features

High profile front conceals roof edge and helps prevent overspill.
Moulded seals provide high level of fitting integrity.
Outlets, unions and angles feature external fixing wings for easy access during installation which saves time.
Choice of hidden or exposed fascia brackets.
None of the fittings have open fixing holes in the wet part of the system.
Integral flexible clips on fittings ease installation.
Manufactured to the requirements of BS EN 607 & EN 1462.

product.name: Brett Martin Cascade Cast Iron Style Shell Plastic Hopper
product.description:
The Cascade Cast Iron Style Rainwater System is synonymous with traditional cast iron styling and blends perfectly with the architectural detailing on heritage buildings, being virtually indistinguishable from original cast ron systems.
The authentic styling of the Cascade system is suitable for both period styled new build and renovation projects alike.
Funnel-shaped rainwater collector that diverts to a downpipe.
Elaborate cast iron and lead versions are of great significance on many façades of historical buildings, on some old houses, hoppers took out grey water, but this is not permitted now.
Features

Authentic detailing and finish on guttering, downpipe, hoppers and fittings
Fully compatible with the Cast Iron Style Soil System and traditional Cast Iron
Incorporates 65mm Square Downpipe and 68mm Round Downpipe
